title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
problem: Manually engineering dense rewards for complex robotic skills is slow and often suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Reward generation need not be restricted to task-specific templates or human-designed reward primitives.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → execute training → summarize component dynamics → mutate the best candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level reward reflection grounds evolutionary edits in observed policy training dynamics.
limitations_evident: Requires repeated GPU-intensive reinforcement learning
Evaluation is in simulation
Final checkpoint selection uses the task metric

title: PromptAgent: Strategic Planning with Language Models Enables Expert-level Prompt Optimization
problem: Expert prompt construction requires costly domain knowledge and inefficient manual exploration.
assumption_broken: Prompt refinement can be planned over future improvements rather than restricted to local paraphrasing.
operational_signature: Collect errors → reflect → expand candidate states → simulate and select paths
load_bearing_mechanism: Monte Carlo tree search directs error-feedback rewrites toward promising future prompt trajectories.
limitations_evident: Requires labeled examples and repeated model calls
Optimizer depends on strong self-reflection
Search hyperparameters selected using validation rewards

title: Plum: Prompt Learning using Metaheuristic
problem: General interpretable prompt optimization must work without gradients or internal model access.
assumption_broken: Prompt transformations and search strategies can be decoupled rather than fixed to a single heuristic.
operational_signature: Segment candidates → edit or recombine → score outcomes → retain and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Composable prompt neighborhoods let discrete metaheuristics search effectively under limited evaluation budgets.
limitations_evident: Global convergence requires restrictive conditions or an infinite horizon
Image quality is optimized against a learned preference proxy
Search behavior depends on chosen metaheuristic

title: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
problem: Repeatedly reasoning over recalled conversation history produces inconsistent answers and costly retrieval.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory can store derived thoughts rather than only raw conversation turns.
operational_signature: Recall relevant thoughts → respond → derive new thoughts → insert, forget, or merge
load_bearing_mechanism: Post-response reasoning persists inductive thoughts and consolidates them for direct later recall.
limitations_evident: Self-generated thoughts can preserve reasoning errors
Medical test set contains only 80 conversations
Additional post-thinking calls are required

title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
problem: Repeated mobile automation through fresh LLM reasoning is unreliable, slow, and costly.
assumption_broken: Past executions can be parameterized and reused at the subtask level rather than regenerated or replayed rigidly.
operational_signature: Explore affordances → select subtasks → execute and store → recall and adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical memory of parameterized subtasks reuses execution procedures across changing task arguments.
limitations_evident: Cost comparisons exclude tasks not completed by all systems
Unsupported image-dominated or non-accessible interfaces
Memory is local to each device

title: Enhancing Open-Domain Task-Solving Capability of LLMs via Autonomous Tool Integration from GitHub
problem: Fixed toolsets prevent agents from solving evolving specialized open-domain queries.
assumption_broken: Agents can acquire and adapt repositories as tools rather than rely on a predefined tool inventory.
operational_signature: Search resources → configure execution → solve and summarize → retrieve prior environments
load_bearing_mechanism: Bi-level experience learning combines community fixes with reusable execution environments and self-summarized practices.
limitations_evident: Experience experiment reruns the same queries on two repositories
Repository changes threaten reproducibility
Docker environments consume substantial resources

title: EASYTOOL: Enhancing LLM-based Agents with Concise Tool Instruction
problem: Inconsistent, redundant, and incomplete tool documentation impairs tool selection and argument generation.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation is an optimizable interface rather than a fixed input to the agent.
operational_signature: Extract purpose → standardize parameters → generate examples → verify execution
load_bearing_mechanism: Concise standardized descriptions plus execution-checked usage examples make tool interfaces easier for models to follow.
limitations_evident: Documentation must fit the model context
Cross-tool dependencies are not modeled
Requires instruction-following models

title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
problem: General computer agents cannot scale manually tailored tools to unfamiliar operating-system applications.
assumption_broken: An agent can acquire application-control tools through its own curriculum instead of requiring a fixed human-built toolkit.
operational_signature: Propose practice tasks → generate tools → execute and critique → retain and retrieve skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed practice accumulates executable tools in procedural memory for reuse on unseen requests.
limitations_evident: Success assessment without ground truth depends on an LLM critic
Spreadsheet evaluation has only 20 tasks
Requires broad operating-system access

title: PRompt Optimization in Multi-Step Tasks (PROMST): Integrating Human Feedback and Heuristic-based Sampling
problem: Long-horizon agent prompts are difficult to refine because failures are hard to diagnose and candidate rollouts are expensive.
assumption_broken: Feedback diagnosis need not come from the LLM itself, and every generated prompt need not receive a full rollout.
operational_signature: Execute candidates → synthesize rule-based feedback → rewrite prompts → filter with learned scores
load_bearing_mechanism: Human-designed error feedback guides prompt revision while an online score predictor prunes costly low-quality evaluations.

improver_modified.how: The score-prediction component is fine-tuned online on newly collected prompt-score pairs.

limitations_evident: Requires task-specific human feedback rules
Search still needs roughly 100 expensive candidate evaluations
Score models need substantial data and local compute

title: Offline Training of Language Model Agents with Functions as Learnable Weights
problem: Manual tool curation and inaccessible model weights limit adaptation of language-model agents.
assumption_broken: Agent functions can serve as trainable parameters while the underlying language model remains frozen.
operational_signature: Evaluate tasks → inspect traces → add, revise, or remove functions → roll back regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive function updates with rollback preserve useful capabilities while optimizing training-set success.
limitations_evident: Small training subsets imposed by context and API cost
Training improvements can overfit and reduce test performance
Optimization requires repeated complete training-set evaluations

title: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs
problem: Manually engineered prompting and agent orchestration fragment systems and leave collaboration structures suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Inter-agent connectivity and node prompts can be optimized instead of remaining fixed architecture choices.
operational_signature: Compose operations → sample connections → execute and score → update connection probabilities and prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE optimizes a distribution over acyclic communication graphs while node-level optimization adapts individual prompts.
limitations_evident: Graphs restricted to directed acyclic structures
Crossword optimization and evaluation reuse a 20-problem subset
Utility evaluation requires repeated graph executions

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models as Prompt Optimizers: Analogical Analysis with Gradient-based Model Optimizers
problem: LLM-based prompt optimizers lack principled guidance for choosing update information and refinement magnitude.
assumption_broken: Prompt update history and edit distance can be controlled analogously to momentum and learning-rate schedules.
operational_signature: Retrieve relevant history → generate constrained variants → score candidates → retain best and decay edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Relevance-selected optimization trajectories and cosine-decayed edit limits guide progressively finer prompt generation.
limitations_evident: Analogy restricted to common first-order optimizers
Relies on textual update directions
Condensed text omits detailed final evaluation splits

title: Agent-Pro: Learning to Evolve via Policy-Level Reflection and Optimization
problem: Action-level self-correction fails to learn strategic policies from delayed feedback in imperfect-information games.
assumption_broken: Reflection can revise underlying beliefs and general behavioral instructions rather than only individual actions.
operational_signature: Play and record beliefs → diagnose failed policies → verify revised instructions → search policy improvements
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-level belief calibration converts failed trajectories into verified behavioral guidelines and world models.
limitations_evident: Evaluated only on Blackjack and Texas Holdem
Strong dependence on foundation-model reflection
Potential gap to state-of-the-art game solvers

title: LLMs in the Imaginarium: Tool Learning through Simulated Trial and Error
problem: Broad tool access does not ensure accurate tool calls even for tools already seen during training.
assumption_broken: Tool expertise can be acquired by imagined practice with real execution feedback rather than static documentation alone.
operational_signature: Imagine scenarios → execute and refine → distill memories → retrieve demonstrations or fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Short-term trial traces and long-term exploration summaries improve the validity and diversity of tool-learning examples.
limitations_evident: Tests are drawn from synthesized exploration examples
End-to-end resolution of time-varying user queries is not evaluated
Positive examples do not teach when to avoid tools

title: Self-Improving Customer Review Response Generation Based on LLMs
problem: High volumes of app reviews make accurate app-specific customer responses difficult to produce manually.
assumption_broken: Response-generation prompts can improve automatically through category-specific judge feedback rather than manual prompt engineering.
operational_signature: Generate grounded responses → judge dimensions → diagnose weak cases → rewrite and rescore prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Category-specific LLM critiques of low-scoring responses are distilled into reusable prompt instructions.
limitations_evident: Only 49 reviews for one application
Judge relevance and specificity correlate negatively with humans on the test set
Accuracy judging uses expert answers unavailable during deployment

title: Prompt Optimization with Human Feedback
problem: Numeric prompt-quality scores are often unavailable or unreliable in direct user interactions.
assumption_broken: Prompt search can use only pairwise preferences rather than scalar scores or labeled validation access.
operational_signature: Generate candidate pool → predict latent utilities → query a preference pair → update the utility model
load_bearing_mechanism: A neural dueling-bandit rule pairs a predicted best prompt with an uncertainty-aware challenger.

improver_modified.how: The latent utility predictor is retrained on accumulated preference observations after each iteration.

limitations_evident: Main prompt experiments simulate preferences rather than collect real user judgments
Optimization is restricted to a pregenerated candidate pool
Does not handle rankings of more than two alternatives

title: Buffer of Thoughts: Thought-Augmented Reasoning with Large Language Models
problem: Reasoning methods repeatedly reconstruct expensive solution structures and fail to reuse general insights.
assumption_broken: Reusable high-level reasoning templates can replace fresh reasoning-structure search for each instance.
operational_signature: Distill constraints → retrieve template → instantiate solution → distill and update templates
load_bearing_mechanism: A dynamically managed meta-buffer stores general thought templates for adaptive instantiation on later problems.
limitations_evident: Limited gains for creative problems
Weak models produce poorer initial templates
Template distillation is not itself optimized

title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
problem: Compound AI systems with nondifferentiable components lack general automated optimization methods.
assumption_broken: Feedback can propagate through arbitrary components in natural language without numeric differentiability.
operational_signature: Execute computation graph → critique objective → backpropagate textual feedback → update variables
load_bearing_mechanism: Context-aware textual gradients attribute downstream criticism to upstream variables for targeted revision.
limitations_evident: Depends on LLMs reasoning accurately about optimized components
Scientific applications validated only in silico
Extra model calls grow with computation-graph edges

title: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
problem: Multi-stage LM programs need jointly effective module prompts without intermediate labels or gradients.
assumption_broken: Instructions and demonstrations across modules can be jointly optimized using only an end-to-end metric.
operational_signature: Bootstrap successful traces → propose grounded instructions → evaluate combinations → update surrogate and select
load_bearing_mechanism: Grounded instruction proposals and Bayesian credit assignment jointly optimize instructions and bootstrapped demonstrations.

improver_modified.how: The MIPRO++ variant learns proposal hyperparameters, including grounding choices and temperature, through Bayesian meta-optimization.

limitations_evident: Fixed budget regime and largely fixed proposer/task models
Complex task rules still require handwritten seed instructions
Grounding can hurt some tasks

title: EvoAgent: Towards Automatic Multi-Agent Generation via Evolutionary Algorithms
problem: Handcrafted agent roles and skills limit scalable construction of effective multi-agent systems.
assumption_broken: Diverse specialized agents can be generated from existing agent settings without individually designing each role.
operational_signature: Initialize agent → evolve diverse settings → quality-check offspring → aggregate outputs and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-simulated evolutionary operators diversify agent settings and integrate complementary candidate results.
limitations_evident: Additional agents increase token cost
Limited comparisons with existing multi-agent frameworks
Generated agent quality not manually assessed

title: Trace is the Next AutoDiff: Generative Optimization with Rich Feedback, Execution Traces, and LLMs
problem: General computational workflows combine heterogeneous parameters and nondifferentiable operations that scalar black-box search optimizes inefficiently.
assumption_broken: Execution traces can provide end-to-end improvement information even when analytic gradients do not exist.
operational_signature: Trace workflow → attach output feedback → extract relevant subgraph → jointly revise parameters
load_bearing_mechanism: OptoPrime uses the minimal execution subgraph to connect rich output feedback to heterogeneous upstream parameters.
limitations_evident: In-place state mutation and distributed workflows require adaptation
Context size and debugging ability bound graph scale
Uses more tokens than OPRO

title: Symbolic Learning Enables Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Manual optimization of isolated prompts and tools fails to improve whole agent pipelines consistently.
assumption_broken: Prompts, tools, and pipeline structure can be jointly learned as symbolic network weights from task data.
operational_signature: Execute and record trajectory → compute language loss → propagate critiques → update symbolic components and roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: Backward-propagated language gradients coordinate symbolic updates with respect to whole-agent outcomes.
limitations_evident: Agent initialization materially affects stability
Open-ended tasks rely on model-generated evaluation
Illegal updates require retries and may be discarded

title: Richelieu: Self-Evolving LLM-Based Agents for AI Diplomacy
problem: Diplomatic agents need long-horizon social strategies without relying on domain-specific human demonstrations.
assumption_broken: Useful strategic experience can be generated through self-play and retained rather than supplied by human games.
operational_signature: Generate experience → retrieve analogous outcomes → critique proposed goals → retain new experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Similarity-retrieved self-play memories guide reflection on strategic sub-goals and negotiations.
limitations_evident: Evaluation is confined to Diplomacy
Real-world incomplete information is not represented
Agents can continue evolving during testing

title: Self-Evolving GPT: A Lifelong Autonomous Experiential Learner
problem: Manually acquiring and selecting task-solving experience cannot scale to an expanding stream of user tasks.
assumption_broken: Task categories and reusable experience can be autonomously discovered and transferred rather than manually predefined.
operational_signature: Categorize requests → transfer related experience → practice and induce rules → store and reuse rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-specific experience induction and cross-task transfer turn self-generated practice into reusable procedural guidance.
limitations_evident: Experience remains noisy and can be ignored by the model
Repeated model calls are expensive
Test inputs guide online learning although labels are withheld

title: AutoFlow: Automated Workflow Generation for Large Language Model Agents
problem: Manually designing effective agent workflows requires substantial domain expertise and limits deployment scale.
assumption_broken: Natural-language workflows can be learned from execution scores rather than fixed by human designers.
operational_signature: Generate workflow → execute on examples → score outcomes → update generator and regenerate
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution-derived rewards optimize a workflow generator while keeping the workflow interpreter frozen.

improver_modified.how: The open-source workflow generator is updated through REINFORCE on LoRA parameters; the closed-source variant instead conditions on prior rewards.

limitations_evident: Experiments use only OpenAGI
Open-source workflows need GPT-4 grammar repair
Reinforcement learning may be inefficient

title: GRAD-SUM: Leveraging Gradient Summarization for Optimal Prompt Engineering
problem: Individual-example prompt critiques produce over-specific candidates and costly evaluation.
assumption_broken: Textual gradients should be aggregated across failures before editing rather than applied independently.
operational_signature: Evaluate responses → critique failures → summarize shared feedback → edit and select prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: A gradient summarization module converts example-specific critiques into generalizable prompt edits.
limitations_evident: Only model-judged metrics are supported
Evaluator biases can distort optimization
User-defined task descriptions and criteria strongly influence quality

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
problem: Hand-designed agent building blocks and workflows constrain the pace and scope of agent development.
assumption_broken: Entire agent designs can be searched as executable programs rather than restricted to predefined prompt or graph spaces.
operational_signature: Inspect discovery archive → program novel design → evaluate and repair → archive scored design
load_bearing_mechanism: An expanding archive preserves stepping stones that a coding meta-agent recombines into novel agent designs.
limitations_evident: Generated programs require isolated execution and safety inspection
Search is constrained by supplied interfaces and model capabilities
Higher-order optimization of the meta-agent remains future work

title: Automated Prompt Engineering for Cost-Effective Code Generation Using Evolutionary Algorithm
problem: Iterative code-repair agents consume many model calls and tokens when starting from inadequate prompts.
assumption_broken: Evolving the initial problem prompt with cheap lexical mutations can replace expensive execution-feedback conversations.
operational_signature: Generate prompt population → execute generated solutions → select by test fitness → mutate and preserve elite
load_bearing_mechanism: Test-fitness-weighted prompt evolution uses inexpensive similar-word substitutions to improve code generation economically.
limitations_evident: Generated internal tests may misrepresent intended behavior
Syntax-tree checks do not establish test semantic correctness
Benchmark coding tasks may not represent real-world development

title: Self-evolving Agents with reflective and memory-augmented abilities
problem: Agents struggle with continuous decisions and information overload as interaction histories grow.
assumption_broken: Historical information should be selectively strengthened, consolidated, and forgotten rather than retained in a simple queue.
operational_signature: Act and receive feedback → reflect on outcomes → strengthen useful memories → retain or forget information
load_bearing_mechanism: MemorySyntax combines reflection with retention-strength thresholds inspired by the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve.
limitations_evident: Selection and evaluation separation is not specified
Iterative feedback depends on checker reliability
Theoretical update assumptions do not establish behavior of discrete prompting

title: Agent Workflow Memory
problem: Web agents fail to reuse common routines across long action trajectories and cannot adapt from past attempts.
assumption_broken: Reusable workflows can be induced from successful trajectories instead of supplied as fixed examples or expert-written routines.
operational_signature: Collect successful trajectories → abstract reusable routines → augment workflow memory → solve subsequent tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained workflow induction removes instance-specific values so stored subroutines compose across tasks.
limitations_evident: Online memory depends on a model judging trajectory success
Workflows are grouped by website rather than pooled universally
Online evaluation adapts to preceding test queries
